title: Anvil Common Schema Definitions v1
description: Shared schema definitions for Anvil configuration files.

name.description: Task name (must match task module filename).

depends_on.description: List of task names that must complete before this task runs.

optional.description: If true, task failure does not fail the account or block dependent tasks.

profile.description: AWS CLI profile for the source authentication context.

regions.description: AWS regions or region selectors for task execution.

role_name.description: Optional IAM role name to assume in target accounts. Organizations default to OrganizationAccountAccessRole at runtime; accounts run directly when omitted.

tasks.description: Tasks to execute for this target group.

max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent account workers.

max_parallel_regions.description: Maximum number of concurrent regions to execute within one account.

max_parallel_targets.description: Maximum number of configured target entries to execute concurrently within one YAML run.

fail_fast.description: Stop processing remaining work for this target group after the first unsuccessful account result.

dry_run.description: Run in dry-run mode without making changes.

name.description: Logical name of this execution target group.
